Any Zoho/local transaction disagreeing with the bank statement is wrong and must be adjusted. FullAccess Zoho token available.

name: account/remote-annual-complete

Stage 1 (Resolve-OrphanReceipts.ps1) runs 4 matching strategies to classify each orphan and, with -Apply, moves duplicates to `_orphans/archived/` and matches to per-account dirs. Stage 2 (Reconcile-ManifestStatus.ps1) audits manifest drift and aligns status/account fields with reality. Use after a manifest update, when `_orphans/` accumulates, or when the manifest's `archived`/`promoted` rows don't match the actual filesystem locations.

name: 4c-bugfix
description: Run a rigorous Concern-Cause-Countermeasure-Check bug fix with a committed failing reproduction, root-cause and sibling analysis, an architectural repair, property/invariant testing, changed-code mutation testing, and full regression proof. Use for non-trivial bugs, regressions, incorrect results, data-handling defects, or requests for a regression-proof fix.
trigger: bugfix, 4c bugfix, agentic bugfix, fix this, why is X broken, regression, this used to work

name: 4c-bugfix-example
description: Worked 4C example: split-payment double-count. Shows the full Concern-Cause-Countermeasure-Check shape with a real red-then-green arc.

name: 4c-cause
description: Find the root cause of a bug with 5-Whys, name the violated invariant, and run a codebase-wide anti-pattern search. Record the analysis in the 4C dossier. Use after 4c-concern has produced a committed failing test. Never start fixing until Cause is documented.

name: 4c-check
description: Verify a 4C bugfix, harden against the bug class, prove a green regression-suite run, and produce the post-hoc code plan in Tasks/Complete/. Use after 4c-countermeasure. Produces the proof (red-then-green, full suite, invariant-and-mutation, blast-radius, plan) that the fix is regression-proof.

name: 4c-concern
description: Red gate of the 4C pattern: pin the failure by writing and committing a failing reproduction test (plus a property test for general invariants) before any application source is modified. Use when starting any non-trivial bug fix, when the reproduction is unclear, or as the first gate of 4c-bugfix. Never skip this gate; a fix without a red repro is not a 4C fix.

name: 4c-countermeasure
description: Implement the architectural fix for a bug and repair every in-scope sibling occurrence identified by 4c-cause. Use after 4c-cause has documented the root cause. Fix the cause, never the symptom.

name: aqe-bridge
description: Call the local AQE (Agent Quality Engine) HTTP bridge for non-blocking quality, security, coherence, and documentation scans. Use inside the 4C bug-fixing gates (4c-concern / 4c-cause / 4c-check), or whenever an AQE quality check is needed. Always fails gracefully - AQE never blocks a fix.
